Horrible Experience – Poor Customer Service and Misleading Policies

I would give zero stars if I could.

Our group had a reservation with Houston Pedal Barge, and the entire experience was frustrating from start to finish. The weather was terrible, with active storms and steady rain throughout the time we were scheduled to be on the water. What makes this even more disappointing is that Houston Pedal Barge’s website states that they monitor weather conditions within two hours of scheduled trips and will cancel trips if necessary due to weather. That never happened in our case.

Before our trip, we repeatedly called and spoke with Conner about the severe weather and requested to cancel and receive a refund. Despite the obvious storm conditions, Conner continuously told us that “the rain will stop in 5 minutes.” We heard this over and over again while standing around waiting. An hour later, it was still raining.

Even more concerning, both the captain, Jason, and Alexia told us that they normally do not take people out in weather like this. If the employees themselves acknowledged that these conditions were not typical or appropriate, why were customers being pressured to proceed instead of being offered a refund or reschedule?

Conner was extremely rude and unprofessional throughout the entire situation. When we asked to speak with someone above him, he told us there was nobody else we could talk to and refused to provide any additional contact information. There was no effort to resolve the issue or show any concern for customer satisfaction.

The boat itself was also not as advertised. We were told it could accommodate 26 people, yet there were only 16 people in our party and there still would not have been enough comfortable seating if everyone had boarded. Every seat was completely soaked from the rain, and there was no way to dry them. To make matters worse, the boat was leaking overhead, meaning we were getting wet even while trying to stand under cover.

After nearly an hour of waiting in the rain and a tremendous amount of arguing back and forth, Conner finally told Captain Jason that he would refund our money. We left believing the issue had finally been resolved. Instead, the person in our group who booked the reservation received a gift card that could only be used with Houston Pedal Barge—not the refund that was promised. To make matters even worse, Conner then blocked her, eliminating any opportunity to discuss the situation or obtain the refund he had agreed to provide.

This experience was a complete failure in customer service, communication, professionalism, and accountability. The company failed to follow its own weather policy, ignored obvious storm conditions, provided a leaking and unusable boat, and then failed to honor a promised refund.

Save your money and book with a company that values customer safety and stands behind its commitments. We will never use Houston Pedal Barge again and would not recommend it to anyone.
